description.value: Tinhouse Brewing is a craft brewery and tasting lounge in Port Coquitlam, located directly off the Traboulay PoCo Trail — one of the Lower Mainland's most popular multi-use cycling corridors. Opened in 2019, the brewery produces a wide range of styles from barrel-aged sours and imperial porters to easy-drinking lagers, with a 30-seat licensed patio and rotating weekend food trucks. The trail-side setting, combined with explicit bike-parking provision, makes it a natural mid-ride destination.

address.value: #2140 - 550 Sherling Place, Port Coquitlam, BC V3B 0J6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website explicitly confirms the brewery is 'right off the Traboulay Poco Trail' and the FAQ states 'We have lots of parking for your bike or your car,' directly evidencing bike parking. Takeout is confirmed via the beer menu listing growler fills, 4-pack, 6-pack, and single cans/bottles to go. The OSM community field reads 'North Vancouver' but both the OSM address tags and website confirm the location is Port Coquitlam — a likely tagging error.
